findings.claim: The early `return null` when SuppressSourceGeneration is true skips all TypeCollector analysis for those types, including security-relevant diagnostics (e.g. MsgPack003/004/005 style checks, MsgPack008 unsupported types). This is the opposite of the requirement, which says the analyzer must still report diagnostics under SuppressSourceGeneration=true. The change leaves users of suppressed types without compile-time warnings, though no MessagePackSecurity setting, depth limit, or comparer is altered. Risk is limited to lost diagnostics rather than weaker deserialization.

receipt_plan.detail: Analyzer test: a [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] class with a public member lacking [Key] or [IgnoreMember]. Expect MsgPack004 to be reported, and observe that it is not.
